The original text of the 《Bencao Jing》: 附子 (fùzǐ), flavor acrid, warm. It governs wind-cold, cough and retching, and evil-qi (風寒咳逆邪氣), warms the center (溫中), metal wounds (金創), breaks hard accumulations and masses (症堅積聚), blood masses (血瘕), cold-damp  (bì), contracture of the knees...
